Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

What is the Solutions Consulting & Engineering Team and why join?

Solutions Consulting & Engineering is an organization that is customer-focused and solutions-led. We deliver end-to-end and emerging solutions to drive customer satisfaction and increase profitability and growth. Our world-class management consulting, delivery excellence, and engineering brilliance enable our success. We embody the OneWWT mindset by bringing the right talent at the right time from anywhere within WWT to solve our customer’s problems. Our goal is to bring together business acumen with full-stack technical know-how to develop innovative solutions for our clients’ most complex challenges.

Position Overview

The Microsoft Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the senior strategic liaison between World Wide Technology Day 2 Operational Services and our portfolio of Microsoft clients. This is not an operational support role — the TAM operates at an executive and architectural level, providing oversight, strategic guidance, and value realization across all Microsoft engagements.
The TAM ensures that every Microsoft client relationship is healthy, growing, and aligned with both client business objectives and WWT's service capabilities. This individual is a trusted advisor who brings deep Microsoft ecosystem expertise to bear in driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term partnership success.

Roles And Responsibilities

The TAM functions as a portfolio-level strategist whose primary objective is to ensure that WWT's Microsoft clients realize maximum value from their technology investments — while expanding the depth and breadth of the WWT relationship.,
Strategic Client Oversight & Portfolio Management
Maintain executive-level awareness of the health, status, and strategic direction of all WWT Microsoft client accounts.
Collaborate with the client’s CSM on regular Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs) with client stakeholders with MSFT technology insights, updates and risks.
Collaborate with the client’s CSM on developing each client’s success plan capturing goals, risks, milestones, and mutual success criteria.
Microsoft Ecosystem Advisory & Technical Guidance
Act as a subject matter authority on the Microsoft product landscape including Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Security (Defender/Sentinel), Copilot, and Modern Work.
Advise clients on Microsoft roadmap developments, licensing changes, and adoption best practices relevant to their environments.
Guide clients through cloud adoption, migration planning, and optimization journeys in alignment with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF).
Translate complex technical capabilities into business value narratives tailored to client executive audiences.
Collaborate with WWT solution architects and engineers to ensure client recommendations are technically sound and deliverable.
Consult with internal D2OS MSFT support engineering teams on advisory and high-complexity cases when needed.
Executive Relationship Management
Build and sustain deep, trust-based relationships with client directors, CIOs, CTOs, VPs of IT, and other senior decision-makers.
Position WWT as an indispensable strategic partner — not merely a transactional vendor — across all Microsoft touchpoints.
Technology Adoption & Value Realization
Champion adoption of Microsoft technologies within client organizations, identifying barriers and developing plans to accelerate usage.
Track utilization metrics, license consumption, and adoption KPIs across client Microsoft environments.
Partner with client teams on change management strategies that support successful technology transitions.
Facilitate access to Microsoft FastTrack, Adoption and Change Management (ACM) resources, and WWT training assets where applicable.
Risk Management & Account Health Monitoring
Maintain a current view of each client's technology health and strategic alignment.
Ensure smooth handoffs and coordination between the TAM function and operational/delivery teams to avoid gaps in client experience.

Qualifications

Required Experience & Education

7+ years of experience in a technical account management, or solutions consulting role within the Microsoft ecosystem.
Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise-level technology client relationships.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
Proven track record of engaging C-suite and VP-level stakeholders with credibility and executive presence.

Required Technical Knowledge

Deep knowledge of the Microsoft cloud and product portfolio: Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot for Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Security.
Familiarity with Microsoft licensing models, Enterprise Agreements (EA), Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA), and MPSA structures.
Understanding of cloud architecture principles, hybrid environments, identity and access management, and modern workplace solutions.
Working knowledge of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected Framework.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (or higher-level Security certs)
ITIL Foundation or higher (preferred, not required)

Core Competencies

Executive communication and executive-level presentation skills — written and verbal
Strategic thinking and business acumen with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes
Strong relationship management skills with a consultative, advisor-first approach
Ability to manage a complex portfolio of accounts simultaneously without losing strategic focus
Collaborative mindset — skilled at working across internal teams including sales, delivery, and technical practices
Data-driven approach to account health, adoption metrics, and client satisfaction

Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you'll be great at this!)
Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

Build strong relationships with Bask's customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals
Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients
Manage all current customer data
Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall

7+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, or Customer Success at a SaaS organization
Experience in e-commerce
Experience with large- to enterprise-sized customer book of business
Creative problem solver with a determination to succeed
Independent and motivated, with the wisdom to seek help where needed
An entrepreneur
